title: Marked Positive Handleslide Pentagons in Compression Bodies: Relative Coherence
summary: Let $W:X\to Y_{\mathrm{geom}}$ be a completed oriented compression body with $N\geq 3$ ordered product $1$-handles and a supplied protected three-handle sector. We realize one positive handleslide pentagon by five diffeomorphisms with compatible complete endpoint markings. An isotopy fixed on the entire protected boundary collar identifies the two-edge and three-edge route composites, so the comparison takes place at the level of marked maps rather than homology matrices.
